title: FR-6537-P-01 Revising the Definition of ‘‘Manufactured Home’’ to Lower Housing Costs
pass_4_primary_concern: The notice should better connect its private cost estimates and statutory interpretation to engineering evidence, alternatives, and implementation safeguards.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal has a coherent affordability and innovation objective, with a targeted material concern about whether engineering and implementation evidence fully supports removing upper-floor chassis requirements.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: If the exemption is not matched by adequate engineering, inspection, and transition controls, new multistory designs could create safety, financing, or compliance problems before the record reveals them.
